name: Dot Matrix Vortex
description: Concentric rings of dots each spin at double the speed of the ring outside them — a gyroscopic vortex where the centre spins fastest

variations.name: default
variations.description: Each concentric ring has one bright active dot that travels its perimeter. Inner rings spin at 2×, 4×, 8× the speed of the outer ring, creating a constantly-changing phase relationship between rings.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the loader in pixels

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the loader in pixels

props.name: dotSize
props.description: Diameter of each dot in pixels

props.name: duration
props.description: Time for the outer ring to complete one full revolution in seconds

props.name: gridSize
props.description: Number of dots per row and column (n × n grid)
